change.description: Change ID, from the step task. Required unless you send reports.

for.description: approve only: what the approval is for.

after_merge.description: True for a step that runs on the merged commit.

result.description: pass, fail with findings, needs_owner, waiting on an event, or close without merge.

commit.description: Full hash of the exact commit you checked: the change head, or the merged commit after merge.

fields.description: Evidence fields the step task asks for, for example {"suite":"full","tests_added":"yes"}, {"findings_open":"0"} or {"merged_commit":"<hash>"}.

done_by.description: Session ID of a worker you started, or owner for direct approval in a delegated approval step. Default: you.

note.description: Findings, command run, why the owner is needed, or the required event for waiting.

until.description: waiting only: RFC 3339 time when evidence can first exist. Reminders pause until new evidence or 24h after this time.

reports.description: Batch form: several reports in one call, each with change, step, result and commit as above. Leave the single-report fields out. A refused report carries its error and the rest still run.

step.description: The reported step, for example accept or approve for merge.

state.description: The step's state after the report.

note.description: Why a pass did not count, when it did not.

missing.description: What the reported step still waits for.

error.description: Batch only: why this report was refused.
